correctness.rationale: Derived exact local flip formula and checked both implications for each of three neighbor sums; exhaustively classified cyclic defects as 1 followed by one or two zeros. Fixed-k marked-defect double counting proves integer n/k binomial coefficient with sharp range. Closed-walk bijection and Cayley-Hamilton prove Perrin recurrence, conjugate-root modulus proves entropy. Standalone exact enumeration and pair-transfer checks passed for even n=4..18 and symbolic charpolys. Finite checks do not underwrite infinite proof.

originality.rationale: Ten completed scientific-prior-art searches and targeted published-literature searches showed no exact weak-field spatially staggered Ising local-minimum census. Full texts distinguish constrained kinetic ferromagnetic models (2002), temporal homogeneous oscillatory field (2015), and critical h/J=2 AF ground-state Lucas counting (2025). The exact weak-field magnetization-resolved Perrin formula is neither the stronger critical-field ground-state result nor a corollary of it. A plausibly related general 1989 spin-glass recursion is an acknowledged inaccessible-source priority risk; no absolute novelty certification is claimed.
residual_risks: The 1989 Masui–Southern–Jacobs article could contain a stronger relevant exact recursion or special case; complete text was inaccessible after lawful access attempts.
The originality search is not a claim of bibliographic completeness; older books or unindexed formulations may contain equivalent counts.
Definitions differ for zero-energy flips; the theorem must not be translated to tie-flipping Glauber dynamics at endpoint fields.

value.rationale: The fixed-field kinetic Ising local-minimum landscape is a motivated observable distinct from equilibrium ground states. The exact magnetization-resolved formula classifies every finite-ring trap and yields the non-Fibonacci plastic entropy over an open physical field window. It quantifies an extensive family of physically meaningful blocked configurations; no basin probability or dynamic lifetime is claimed.
